# semaphore_ex_project_environment_sync (Action)

Synchronizes configured project-environment secret references explicitly. The action returns after the server completes the request and does not expose secret values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "semaphore_ex_project_environment_sync" "production" {
  config {
    project_id     = 1
    environment_id = 3
  }
}

# terraform apply -invoke=action.semaphore_ex_project_environment_sync.production
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (Number) Environment whose configured secret references will synchronize.
- `project_id` (Number) Project owning the target.
